objective: Prospectively evaluate the unchanged direct-aperture source-depletion implementation on two public PRESLHY E3.1 cryogenic campaigns that were not previously extracted or numerically evaluated in this repository.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only a bounded 80 K direct-aperture source-depletion component claim for the named PRESLHY packages. It does not validate cryogenic two-phase flow, ignition, dispersion, flame radiation, station control, refuelling, vehicle operation or emergency separation distance.

source.license: CC BY 4.0 as declared by the public record
source.rights_boundary: The public packages are read from the source cache for evaluation. Raw workbook rows are not copied into the repository; only aggregate metrics, case identifiers and source hashes are retained in the result artifact.

amendments.change: Corrected the D05 package manifest MD5 mapping after reading the public archive checksum manifest; the checksum belongs to PRE3P1A_KIT_D05_80K-DATA.zip, while the adjacent checksum line belongs to the next package.
amendments.basis: Archive metadata only; no workbook payload or numerical outcome was opened before this correction.

amendments.change: Corrected the D2 package manifest MD5 mapping after the runner verified the D05 package and stopped before reading the D2 package. The D05 numerical result was not written or used for a decision; the complete run is repeated from this amended protocol.
amendments.basis: Checksum-only runner stop; no parameter, threshold, case selection or time alignment changed.

frozen_model.source_depletion: real-gas source inventory with measured initial pressure and gas temperature
frozen_model.ambient_boundary: measured workbook ambient pressure only; substituted ambient pressure is ineligible
frozen_model.integration: existing LSODA evaluator with its locked tolerances and bounded max step

include: finite synchronized source-pressure trace with at least 20 unique time samples
measured gas-side initial temperature from 60 K through 120 K
measured ambient pressure and no substituted boundary
all workbook files in both named packages that satisfy the fixed reader
exclude: reader failures, missing ambient pressure, substituted temperature or duplicate records
files containing only downstream or imaging channels without a source-pressure trace

aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: A failed result remains archived; no parameter, threshold, case selection or time alignment may be changed after numerical outcomes are opened.
